notes.title: Demo v0.0.4
notes.notes:
[h1]Demo v0.0.4 has been released! 😃[/h1]
[list]
[*] We've added an in-game feedback form where you can send us messages with screenshots attached
[*] The Game Over screen now has a button to copy a screenshot to your clipboard so you can easily share your runs!
[*] Various performance/stability fixes
[/list]
